provenance.note: Roadmap is the orchestrator's recommended cut, approved by the user.

steps.objective: Collapsible Sessions sidebar — a collapse toggle on the list<->detail shell so the chat pane gets full width. Frontend-only: railCollapsed state in SessionsRoute, data-collapsed on .session-shell-body, a toggle control; collapsed = thin strip. Optionally persist the bit to localStorage.
Tool chips quieter by default — the ToolUseChip result body already collapses; also gate the always-on 120-char input peek behind expand so a collapsed chip is a bare name + outcome dot.
Bulk collapse/expand all tools + thinking blocks — a transcript- or turn-level expand-all/collapse-all control. Companion to R2; the real quiet-transcript lever.

Render the user's own prompt in the transcript (defect fix — the prompt is sent but never shown). Append a synthetic prompt TranscriptEntry on turn dispatch (start + sendTurn) + a TranscriptRow prompt branch (right-aligned user bubble). Add a Rust PersistedEntry append in run_turn so the prompt survives a restart/reopen.
Transcript autoscroll + jump-to-latest — stick-to-bottom as streaming deltas append, pausing on user scroll-up, with a jump-to-latest pill.
Copy affordances — hover copy buttons on assistant text cards, tool-result bodies, and code fences.

Model + thinking-effort selection. build_args gains --model (aliases opus/sonnet/haiku/opusplan/default + [1m]) and --effort (low/medium/high/xhigh/max); optional --fallback-model; an ultrathink per-prompt toggle. New StartSessionParams + SessionHandle + SessionRecord/SessionSummary fields (rebuilt on --resume). Composer options-disclosure model + effort selects. Set showThinkingSummaries so Opus 4.7 thinking blocks are not empty. Flags verified against official claude-code docs.
Prompt token estimate — a new estimateTokens.ts heuristic (~chars/4) showing a labelled '~N tokens' for the composer draft; optionally a projected '+N this turn' overlay on the ContextGauge.
Stop / interrupt a running turn — a UI control that cancels the in-flight turn via the existing cancel_session command, surfaced prominently while a turn streams.
Retry / edit-and-resend a turn — a control on a user prompt bubble (R4) to resend that prompt, or edit it and resend, as a fresh turn.
Keyboard navigation — an Enter-to-send preference toggle, Esc to cancel a running turn, and a session-cycle shortcut across the rail.
Conversation forking — branch a session via claude-code's --fork-session (a new session id on resume), so a user can explore an alternate path without losing the original.
@-file mentions — typing @path in the composer pulls a project file reference into the prompt.
Session + transcript search — a filter box on the session rail and an in-conversation find within a transcript.
